text.tspan: Part B: pc1 pings pc2 while pc3 listens
br0 learns pc1's MAC on port1
br0 learns pc2's MAC on port2
no flooding, so pc3 sees nothing
The switch's table (FDB) at the end
pc1's MAC → port1 · pc2's MAC → port2 · pc3 is missing: it never sent a frame
Entries age out after ageing_time 30000 = 300 seconds
